headline: Gorirat power mode
title: Gorirat | Wood Worker With a Power Surge | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want a lumber Pal that also fights in Palworld one point zero? Gorirat is a Neutral Pal whose partner skill, Full Power Gorilla Mode, raises its own Attack by seventy five to three hundred percent for a limited time. At base it works Lumbering level three, Transporting level three and Handiwork level two. Will you take Gorirat? Comment below!
description: Gorirat in Palworld 1.0 is a Neutral Pal with Lumbering level three and an Attack boost partner skill.
